claim: EV-0053 binds the CP22 codec evidence to the clean runtime child, the prepare journal, and the CP21 root anchor. The child commit adds a fixed payload-v2 record family with capability dependencies and strict ownership/padding/CRC validation. The accepted boundary remains codec/admission-only: no daemon mapping handler, kernarg publication, AQL submission, normal launcher, gem5 execution, or fallback is claimed.
command_argv:
set -eu
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
r=Path('projects/self-amdgpu-runtime')
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(r),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(); tree=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(r),'rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],text=True).strip(); parent=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(r),'rev-parse','HEAD^'],text=True).strip()
assert head=='02adb53580c7b7ffef65973dd178fd954e06cf09' and tree=='564a48a12b3689cda3046ea72cd59d66d85e08f2' and parent=='386713738a9eb050394e74152fe5acaf16435abe'
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(r),'status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all'],text=True)==''
print(json.dumps({'head':head,'tree':tree,'parent':parent,'branch':subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(r),'branch','--show-current'],text=True).strip(),'clean':True},sort_keys=True))
PY
